title: What Does the USDA Organic Seal Really Mean?
summary: VOA profile of a Maryland organic grower on flavour, labour and the USDA's global organic certification system.

assertions.quote: organic foods are more expensive than their supermarket counterparts
this tastes much better than any of that cardboard II junk in the stores
growing organic vegetables takes more work

verdicts.note: Across 44 comparison studies, labour costs were significantly higher on organic crops (13%) and systems (7%), offset by lower purchased inputs, because organic farms do more mechanical pest control and run more enterprises; labour is measured as cost, not hours.

assertions.quote: all farms and businesses around the world are following the same rules
